explanation: Build a character trie of all dictionary words, then backtrack over board paths that remain trie prefixes. Mark the current path’s cells to forbid reuse. Remove terminal markers after reporting words, and prune exhausted branches to avoid duplicate reports.
timeComplexity: O(S + R C 4^L) conservative upper bound for total dictionary characters S, board R-by-C and maximum word length L.
spaceComplexity: O(S + R C + L) trie/visited/recursion space, plus returned words.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 Python algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
